images.name: Virginia International Gateway
images.description: Virginia International Gateway is the private owner of the highly automated VIG marine container terminal in Portsmouth, Virginia. The terminal handles containerized cargo for ocean carriers, beneficial cargo owners, railroads, motor carriers and regional supply chains; Astatine describes approximately 2 million TEU of annual throughput capacity. Virginia International Gateway, Inc. owns the terminal, the Virginia Port Authority leases it under a long-term facilities lease, and the authority's Virginia International Terminals subsidiary operates it. The facility opened in 2007 as APM Terminals Virginia. Affiliates of Alinda-managed funds and USS acquired it in August 2014 and renamed it VIG. Astatine now lists one VIG profile as Active and a separate Fund II investment as exited in 2019. The Virginia Port Authority's August 2025 final official statement identifies USS and PSP as the current underlying owners, supporting an active Astatine manager attribution and an active PSP direct-owner association while preserving the realized Fund II period. The active Astatine fund or managed-account vehicle, manager-level stake and entry date, plus PSP's entry date and percentage, are not publicly disclosed. No later full sale, signed pending exit or transfer of terminal title to the port authority was identified through August 18, 2026. APM Terminals Virginia is the predecessor name; VPA, VIT, lease interests, bonds, cranes and expansion projects are not separate PortCos.

milestones.event: APM Terminals commissioned the privately owned Portsmouth container terminal later renamed Virginia International Gateway.
Affiliates of investment funds managed by Alinda Capital Partners and Universities Superannuation Scheme acquired APM Terminals Virginia and renamed the terminal owner Virginia International Gateway.
Astatine reports that its Alinda Infrastructure Fund II investment in Virginia International Gateway was exited in 2019; the manager separately retains an Active VIG profile.

The amended VIG lease became effective after the Virginia Port Authority made an upfront rent payment and secured a fixed-price purchase option for 2065; the official statement continued to identify VIG as privately owned by USS and PSP.
